rationale: Load data, measure fraud prevalence and imbalance, then compare a comprehensive set of claim characteristics (type, billing amounts, service details, flags) and member demographics (age, sex, race/ethnicity, payer type) between flagged and unflagged claims. Include leakage assessment to flag protected attributes and label-derived fields. Report with caveats for class imbalance, non-causal scope, and descriptive limits; show denominators and cite artifacts for full transparency.
